question: how many open jobs does each department have?
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, COUNT(*) n FROM work_orders wo JOIN departments d ON d.id=wo.department_id WHERE wo.status IN ('IN PROGRESS','CREATED','SUBMITTED','PENDING MOVE APPROVAL') GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY n DESC
agent_sql_scrubbed:
SELECT d.name AS department_name, COUNT(w.id) AS open_jobs_count
FROM departments d
LEFT JOIN work_orders w ON w.status IN (?, ?, ?, ?)
GROUP BY d.id;
